title: Disappearance of Sharon, the space-kid psychic

tellings.quote: And she just disappeared. And everyone who knew her back then was like, you know, it would be amazing if you found her because she They're convinced that she was pulled into a you know, Stranger Things Montauk project type project where like she was the real deal and she was sort of pulled into a project like that.

plain: A girl named Sharon, one of the "space kids", psychic children studied in the 1970s by the researcher of psychic powers Andrija Puharich, is said to have simply disappeared. The researcher Greg Malatzi passes on what people who knew her back then told him: they are convinced she was "the real deal" and was pulled into a secret project like the rumored Montauk experiments, the kind of thing shown in the TV show Stranger Things. If true, it would mean a government program took in a child for her psychic gifts.
